_about: Public-domain Henry Whitney Bellows (1814-1882), Unitarian minister of All Souls Church, New York, and president of the U.S. Sanitary Commission, for the Word Hoard: his sermons and religious addresses: ordination and installation sermons, The Christian Merchant, The Alleged Failure of Protestantism, Religious Education, The Importance of a Positive Theology, The Suspense of Faith, his Civil War sermons, his discourse on Thomas Starr King, Re-statements of Christian Doctrine (1867), Church and State in America, his Bryant funeral oration, and Twenty-four Sermons (1886). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 92 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
